titulo.alumno:
«Повествователь и точка зрения»
Narrator and point of view

intro: The narrator is not always the same as the author; observe pronouns, access to information and evaluations to recognise their perspective.

piezas.titulo: The narrator is not always the same as the author; observe pronouns, access to information and evaluations to recognise their perspective.
texto: The narrator is not always the same as the author; observe pronouns, access to information and evaluations to recognise their perspective.
A narrative can leave events unexplained and allow several inferences; separate what the text says from what you imagine.

frases.estudio: Рассказчик описывает события только через воспоминания главной героини.
frases.alumno: The narrator recounts events only through the memories of the female protagonist.

frases.estudio: Читатель узнаёт о решении героя лишь после того, как его последствия становятся заметны.
frases.alumno: The reader learns of the character's decision only when its consequences become visible.

pregunta.texto: Through which perspective are the events related?

opciones.explicacion: The first sentence limits the information to the protagonist's memories.
